name: Financial numeric and source-grounding evaluation
description: Evaluate a reported financial value together with its declared unit and period, then summarize reference-evidence coverage and independent human support annotations.

prediction.value.description: Finite reported numeric value, before any scoring. Extract it under a documented parsing protocol.

reference.value.description: Independently verified finite numeric reference for the same question, unit, and period.

prediction.unit.description: Explicit unit identifier, for example USD_million. Must exactly match the reference unit; no currency, percentage, or scale conversion is performed.

reference.unit.description: Verified unit identifier using the same vocabulary as prediction.unit.

prediction.period.description: Predicted reporting-period identifier, for example FY2025. Fiscal/calendar semantics must be resolved by the dataset author.

reference.period.description: Verified reporting-period identifier for the item.

prediction.evidence_ids.description: Unique or repeated source identifiers cited in the answer; repetitions are deduplicated.

reference.evidence_ids.description: Independent set of required supporting source IDs. An empty set is not applicable for recall; a missing field is missing evidence.

human_review.support_score.description: Independent financial-data review, integer 0-4: 0 contradicts supplied evidence; 1 has a major unsupported calculation or claim; 2 is partly supported but omits material assumptions; 3 supports the central result with minor explanation gaps; 4 supports the result, assumptions, units, and period completely. This is a research annotation, not financial advice or an audit opinion.

metadata.dataset_version.description: Optional immutable dataset/split version for traceability. Not required or verified by this scorer.

metadata.model_version.description: Optional model/checkpoint version that produced the predictions. Not required or verified by this scorer.

human_review.reviewer_id.description: Optional independent reviewer identifier. The scorer does not authenticate the reviewer or validate qualifications; synthetic examples do not identify a real reviewer.

human_review.rubric_version.description: Optional version of the human-review instructions used to assign ratings. The scorer does not verify adherence to that rubric.

metrics.name: Value and unit accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction with identical declared units and numeric absolute error no greater than 0.01 of that unit.
metrics.limitations: The 0.01 absolute tolerance is an explicit starter setting, not a universal financial standard. Calibrate it for rounding and unit scale; no conversion or arithmetic derivation is performed.

metrics.name: Reporting-period accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction of reporting-period labels matching the supplied reference.
metrics.limitations: Label agreement does not verify fiscal-calendar definitions, reporting revisions, or whether the value came from that period.

metrics.name: Required evidence-ID recall
metrics.description: Mean fraction of independently required evidence IDs present in the prediction.
metrics.limitations: Matches supplied IDs only. It does not open sources, verify that a source exists, or establish that a citation supports the answer. Extra unsupported citations are not penalized by recall.

metrics.name: Human-reviewed financial support
metrics.description: Mean independently reviewed support score normalized from 0-4 to 0-1.
metrics.limitations: This imports an independent review score; the engine neither performs the review nor verifies reviewer identity. Missing reviews are excluded and reduce coverage.

limitations: This is a reusable evaluation template, not an official benchmark scorer. All targets are unset; calibrate thresholds and minimum coverage on a representative held-out dataset. Scores are not automatically used as screening gates or RL rewards.
Numeric, unit, and period checks remain separate signals; this pack does not issue a financial correctness or release verdict.
This is not FinQA execution accuracy or program accuracy. No financial calculation program is executed.
All example entities, source IDs, and review annotations are synthetic.
Unused metadata and review-provenance fields are optional traceability suggestions; their presence, authenticity, and types are not validated unless a metric references them.
